category_definition.ALL_SEVEN_PASS: All seven displayed conditions PASS; remaining technical gates are retained separately.
category_definition.INFORMATION_INSUFFICIENT: At least one original unknown/NOT_ESTABLISHED condition; known FAIL intersections remain recorded.
category_definition.MULTIPLE_FAIL: At least two FAIL conditions and no unknown condition.
category_definition.ONLY_ONE_FAIL: Exactly one FAIL and no unknown condition.

dimension_definition.Final: Original final_answer_consistency, additionally forbidding PASS when no actual Final was delivered. Raw consistency and delivery stay separate.
dimension_definition.execution: Observed existence of at least one successful calculate: PASS if present, FAIL if absent. No claim about why absent.
dimension_definition.quantity: Original task_answer_status including original secondary/Final-amount checks.

guard.scope: process-local Python audit hooks; not absolute OS isolation
